caption:
Same ad. Same budget. Two audiences. Completely different results.

WARM — people who already know you:
→ Your followers
→ Anyone who liked, commented, reposted or shared in the last 30, 60 or 90 days
→ Everyone who watched 50%+ of your videos

They already trust you. Lower cost per lead, faster close.

COLD — people who never heard of you:
→ Interests only. The algorithm is guessing.
→ More testing, higher cost per lead. But it's the only way to find new buyers.

The play: cold fills the pipeline. Warm closes the sale. Running only one of them is leaving money on the table.

📌 Send this to someone who only ever advertises to strangers.
